description: Election Commission  - Mr. J. N. S. Kumar at the Nattandiya P.S. has Vacated his Office of Member Mrs. T. Supashini of the Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated her Office
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating offices and changes in candidate status.
